tagline: Bill it, send it, get paid.
intro: Bill turns the work your team already tracked into invoices a client can read and pay. You build a draft, fill it with line items, finalize it to lock a permanent number, send it, and record payments until the balance hits zero. Along the way it captures expenses with an approval step, resolves billing rates so tracked time prices itself, and reports on revenue, aging, and profitability. By the end of this chapter you can stand up your billing identity, send a finalized invoice, and read the numbers at the close of a period.
atAGlance: Draft-to-paid invoice lifecycle: finalize locks the number, payments close the balance
Money in integer cents everywhere, so the inputs never round or guess
Recurring schedules that bill a client on a cadence without re-drafting
Time-based billing that resolves the most specific rate that applies
Full MCP coverage, so an agent can draft and collect while a human approves and sends

callouts.after: All money in Bill is stored and entered in
callouts.text: Every amount, rate, and payment field is in whole cents, not dollars. Typing 150 means one dollar and fifty cents, so multiply your dollar figure by 100 before you enter it and nothing rounds.

callouts.after: is computed from the due date as any unpaid, finalized invoice
callouts.text: Overdue is not a stored status. It is computed live from the due date as any unpaid, finalized invoice that is past due, which is why the Dashboard Overdue tile, the Invoices list Overdue pill, and the Reports overdue table all agree.

callouts.after: Bill rejects a payment that would exceed the remaining balance
callouts.text: A payment cannot push an invoice past paid. Bill rejects any receipt larger than the remaining balance, so record the actual amount received rather than rounding up to the total.

Open /bill/, click Bill Settings, fill in your Company Name and an Invoice Prefix, and click Save Settings. Watch for the Saved! confirmation, then your next invoice carries those details on its from side.

quiz.q: How is money stored and entered throughout Bill?
choices: In the org's default currency only

quiz.q: Which invoice action requires an admin or owner role rather than plain write access?
choices: Adding a line item to a draft

quiz.q: Once you finalize an invoice, what two things become locked?
quiz.answer: Its number is assigned permanently and its line items can no longer be edited; invoices are only editable while in draft.

choices: Yes, the app sets it like draft or paid
No, it is computed from the due date
Only after a reminder email sends
quiz.answer: No, it is computed from the due date

quiz.q: Name the six invoice status values that the app actually sets.
quiz.answer: draft, sent, viewed, partially_paid, paid, and void.

quiz.q: What three states make up the expense lifecycle from submission to terminal step?
quiz.answer: An expense starts pending, a reviewer moves it to approved (or rejected), and an approved expense can be moved on to reimbursed.

quiz.q: When Bill bills tracked time, which rate does it use?
choices: The most specific rate that applies
The rate on the first time entry
quiz.answer: The most specific rate that applies

quiz.q: What happens when you record a payment larger than the remaining balance?
choices: The invoice flips to paid and the extra is credited
The overage becomes a new draft invoice

quiz.q: What is the difference between a recurring schedule's Auto-finalize mode and its Draft mode?
quiz.answer: With Auto-finalize on, every generated invoice is assigned a number and marked sent automatically; with it off (Draft), each run produces a draft for you to review, finalize, and send by hand.

quiz.q: Can a client pay through the public invoice view that the view token opens?
choices: Yes, it has a Pay Now button
No, it is view-and-PDF only and you record payments yourself
quiz.answer: No, it is view-and-PDF only and you record payments yourself

quiz.q: What invoice number format does the live finalizer produce, and what form should you not expect?
quiz.answer: It produces {prefix}-{number:05d}, for example INV-00001; year-based forms like INV-2026-0042 from some seed data are not what finalize generates.

quiz.q: Which expenses count against profit in the Project Profitability report?
Marking an approved expense reimbursed has no dedicated MCP tool. How does an agent or user do it?
quiz.answer: It is a UI and REST action via POST /bill/api/v1/expenses/:id/reimburse, with no dedicated MCP tool.
